integrity.mathematical_basis: analytic proof with symbolic curvature identity, Jensen strictness and two-point constructive continuity

scientific_limitations: Assumes a known common emissivity index, exact narrow-band monochromatic frequency ratios 1:2:4, finite positive temperatures and component weights, and optically thin thermal radiation.
Finite calibration errors, filter convolution, temperature/emissivity coupling, additional emission mechanisms and optical-depth effects can invalidate a physical inference.
Feasibility of a two-temperature fit does not identify the actual temperatures or component weights uniquely.
Sharp unattained upper boundary uses temperatures tending to zero and infinity; it may be quantitatively irrelevant under bounded physical temperatures.
Historical priority not independently verified; general convex-gamut arguments and unlocated spectroscopy literature remain residual coverage risks.
title: Sharp two-temperature completion of a three-band dust-color region
